requirements.text: SHK verify evidence must bind the exact Git commit, tree, dirty state, execution mode, issuer trust level, and canonical evidence digest.
SHK must provide a reusable verifier that rejects tampered, stale, dirty, wrong-mode, insufficient-trust, or unauthenticated higher-trust evidence with structured verdicts.

Existing SHK consumers must not accept digest-invalid READY evidence or fail open when the attestation verifier is unavailable; legacy compatibility must be explicit and fail-closed when attestation is present or required.

design.summary: Add reusable evidence attestation, delivery-target binding, managed-file upgrade safety, and runner cleanup guarantees to public SHK.
changed_areas: scripts/lib evidence attestation and guarded runner

risk_points.text: A digest can be circular, unstable, or silently omit protected fields, producing false integrity.
Enforcing attestation too broadly can reject legacy evidence and self-lock existing projects.
Treating a JSON trust declaration as authenticated, or calling local-self evidence independently trusted, would overstate the security boundary.
An unavailable verifier dependency can be mistaken for a compatibility case and silently admit attested or strict evidence.

traffic_flows.name: project candidate admission
steps: validate fixed attestation format and recompute digest
authenticate any trust level above local-self through an external boundary
emit structured verdict and exit code

traffic_flows.name: delivery evidence consumption
steps: read strict compatibility policy before verifier fallback
validate attestation when present or required
fail closed when verifier is unavailable for attested/strict evidence
preserve only the documented non-strict legacy behavior

assertions: local-self is not reported as signed or independent
local issuer cannot issue a higher trust level
recomputed ci-signed JSON fails without authenticated_trust_level
fixed protected_scope cannot be changed and re-digested

test_plan.scenario: temporary real Git repository generates, verifies, tampers, and stales evidence
assertions: new commit makes expected current identity fail
legacy behavior follows explicit flag or policy
CLI rejects a recomputed unauthenticated high-trust declaration
delivery, verification, and stage consumers block attested evidence when the verifier module is unavailable
non-strict unattested legacy evidence retains the documented upgrade compatibility

acceptance.text: Generated evidence is bound to exact Git and execution provenance and has a reproducible canonical digest.
The reusable CLI rejects every requested stale, tampered, policy-mismatch, or unauthenticated high-trust case and accepts the positive control.
Critical evidence consumers reject digest-invalid, unauthenticated, or verifier-unavailable READY evidence without creating a non-strict legacy deadlock.
